title: Retrieval eval reports reachable and total denominators
body:
Astra audit B4 (mechanism verified): evals/retrieval/run.ts:105-106 drops labels no channel can reach from the denominator and skips cases with none, so recall at edit time is overstated.
Files: evals/retrieval/run.ts, test/evals/retrieval-denominator.test.ts
Outcome: the retrieval report prints reachable and total denominators per moment; the test exits 0.
Proof: node --test test/evals/retrieval-denominator.test.ts passes and node evals/retrieval/run.ts prints both denominators.
